cards.title: Open ASR Leaderboard Adds Indian English & Hindi Benchmarks With 4,888 Speakers
cards.why_it_matters: ASR bias across demographics is a known blind spot in standard WER leaderboards, and this dataset gives researchers a concrete, demographically rich tool to measure and address it — directly relevant if you work on speech, multilingual models, or evaluation methodology.
cards.summary: The Open ASR Leaderboard now includes Monsoon en-IN and Monsoon hi-IN evaluation sets — the first Indic language and first Global South data on the leaderboard. Each language has public and private splits, totaling 4,888 speaker-disjoint speakers with 12 recorded attributes. Data varies across geography, age, gender, devices, acoustic conditions, vocabulary, speech type, and speech rate, collected via unscripted dual-channel conversations across hundreds of Indian districts.
